RESEAU DES ROUTES PRINCIPALES SUISSES (RPS) SUR LE CANTON DE GENEVE Le réseau des routes principales suisses bénéficiaires d'une subvention fédérale est défini dans l'Ordonnance concernant l'utilisation de l'impôt sur les huiles minérales à affectation obligatoire dans le trafic routier (OUMin). Coverage: Kanton Genf. The portal files it under the publisher Kanton Genf. It offers 7 resource(s) in API, CSV, GML, KML, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
